messages:
Ava (People Ops): Heads-up everyone — we’ve tightened the timeline on SOC2/ISO evidence collection for this cycle. New hard deadline to upload artifacts is 2026-04-10 23:59 PDT. Please don’t wait until the last minute.
Molly (People Ops): Short version: if you own any control evidence (access docs, runbooks, config screenshots), drop them into the secure form ASAP: <https://redwood-internal/forms/compliance-evidence|evidence form>. Mark the control IDs in the form.
Jon (Security): Quick note from security: we need the following for affected services — access matrix exports, 2 recent on-call rotas, and a statement describing any recent config drift. If you have automated exports, paste the S3 path or upload via the form.
Priya (Eng): Question — what counts as a valid "config screenshot"? We have a few infra-as-code templates and terraform state.
Jon (Security): Priya — for IaC: a link to the repo + the relevant commit hash OR a rendered console screenshot showing the live setting. If you provide both, even better.
Liam (Legal): Reminder: redact any sensitive customer data before upload. If in doubt, ping legal@redwood. We can advise redaction patterns.
Molly (People Ops): Also adding 2 optional things that speed review: a one-line summary (control -> artifact mapping) and the approximate date the artifact was generated.
Ava (People Ops): We’re running three 30-minute office hours next week: Mon 10am, Wed 3pm, Fri 11am in #people-ops-help for walkthroughs and quick validations. Bring one example and we’ll confirm.
Priya (Eng): Can eng teams request a short extension if there’s a blocker? Our release next week conflicts with some folks.
Ava (People Ops): Extensions possible but limited — must be requested through the form and approved by Jon + Molly. Try to avoid.
Molly (People Ops): If you’ve already uploaded artifacts for last quarter, we’ll reuse where applicable — but double-check the dates. We’ll message if we need an update.
Jon (Security): For infra teams: if you use automated evidence collection (scripts that output CSV/JSON), include a short README in the upload describing the script and cadence.
Priya (Eng): Thanks — we’ll collate and submit a bundle.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: compliance-data-export v2 -> runs nightly until 2026-04-08 :gear: (this is informational)
Liam (Legal): One more: all contributors must complete the 15-min privacy refresher by 2026-04-05. It’s in the Learning portal. Completion helps speed sign-off.
Ava (People Ops): TL;DR: deadline 2026-04-10, use the secure form, office hours next week, extensions by request only. Ping @Ava or @Molly for help. :thumbsup:
Molly (People Ops): If you complied already: reply with "Uploaded: <control list>" so we can tick the checklist.
Priya (Eng): Uploaded: IAM-01, OT-03, INF-02 — just added the commit hashes and README.
Jon (Security): Got it, starting reviews now. Expect a note in two business days if anything is missing.
Ava (People Ops): Thanks team — appreciate the quick turnaround on this.
